name: Princess Huhuran
notes: Numbers follow docs/research/temple-of-ahnqiraj/huhuran.md. Wowhead's 5,829,623 HP is a 'Seasonal 40 Player' value, so HP here is a clock: three phases over 185 s (real kills take 3 to 4 min; the 5 min timed enrage is not reached and not simulated). ESTIMATES: the room is a 40 yd circle from prose, and melee 900 per 2 s plus Acid Spit (55 per second per stack, scaled from the real 125 per second per stack because a 10,000 HP sim tank at 10 real stacks would melt in eight seconds) is what a 10,000 HP tank must survive on passive healing (`healPerSecond` 900 player tank, 920 ghost, 140 ghost with a player healer). Tank swap: she is taunt-immune and the real swap is by threat. Like Fankriss and Kurinnaxx this is a scripted `restWindow` + `targetSwitch`: about every 50 s (about 8 Acid Spit stacks, the guides swap at 7 to 10), the player tank waits 30 s while the stacks fall off (the real rule), and Taunt stands in for building threat back, not a real Taunt. The ghost tank roles see the same empty 30 s window as a boss hitting nobody, and Acid Spit does not move to a real second tank in this model. Frenzy: a `debuff` on the tank (`dispel: enrage`), removed by the ranged role's `dispel` button limited to `enrage` by `roles.ranged.dispels` (Tranquilizing Shot), every ~15 s for 8 s (BW 14.5 s, DBM 11.3 to 25.9 s) cast first at 8 s. Poison Bolt (`aoe`, radius 14 from her edge to the 'soakers', 1,500 per bolt, every 4 s) fires only while Frenzy is up (`conditional`), so a Tranq in time prevents it; for roles without the button nobody in the sim removes it, so tanks and melee eat one or two bolts per Frenzy that a working hunter team would have prevented (the one misrepresentation here, in the direction of too much damage on those roles). The real '15 closest' targeting cannot be expressed; the 14 yd radius is its stand-in: soakers (the melee role, real 200+ nature resist) are inside it, ranged and healers outside. The hunter seat is the only role this script asks to press Tranq on a cue; real rotations are two or three hunters. Wyvern Sting: two actions because the engine dispel cannot choose. `wyvernStingTank` lands on whoever tanks (Poison; the healer cleanses it, the 3,000 damage on cleansing is not simulated; 5 s of `stun` on a player tank standing in for the time to be dispelled) and `wyvernStingRaid` on random non-tanks (`dispel: none`, 12 s `stun`, `playerChance` 0.25: the 'never dispel raiders' rule is enforced by making it undispellable, so a healer can no longer waste a dispel on it, which is the opposite of a choice). DBM's 25.9 to 59.2 s cadence is 26 s with 8 s of jitter. The real rule that damage wakes you is not modelled. Noxious Poison: 375 per second for 8 s on a random non-tank (`playerChance` 0.3) plus a `forbidAbilities` Silence on the healer role only (spell data: 750 per 2 s for 8 s, undispellable). The 15 yd splash and the spread-in-stacks rule are tips only. Acid Spit's unresistable tick is simulated as `tickDamage` per stack. Phase 3 Berserk at 30% (DBM pre-warns at 35%): `enrage` with `enrageMultiplier` 1.25 (real: +200% attack speed), Sting, Noxious and Frenzy stop as in boss mods, and Poison Bolt becomes 1,000 (800 on a ghost tank) every 3 s, unconditional, on the soak ring (real 2 to 3 s and 1,500 to 2,500, scaled to the sim's 10,000 HP soak ring). The poison-resist soak is expressed by `poisonBoltSoak`: it hits the 14 yd ring (soakers: melee role must be there, scored by `playerAtSpotBy`) and misses the raid; nothing scores it when a soaker is missing, and the real shift of bolts onto cloth when a soaker dies is not modelled. Tranq and the dispel-only-tanks rule become tips here. Fidelity correction: Threat burst now adds a fixed amount of threat in melee range. It no longer copies the top threat or forces a target. The automated raid holds damage while a tank recovers aggro.

boss.looseHint: Build threat in melee range. This boss cannot be taunted.

tank.label: Main tank
tank.description: Face her away from the raid and take the Acid Spit. Around eight stacks another tank takes over: press nothing for 30 seconds while your stacks fall off, then build threat and take her back.

melee.label: Melee DPS
melee.description: You are a soaker. Stay on her, inside the closest group. When she berserks at 30% everything goes on you.

ranged.label: Ranged DPS
ranged.description: You hold the Tranq. Tranquilizing Shot every Frenzy, inside 4 seconds. Stay spread and far away the rest of the time.

healer.label: Healer
healer.description: Cleanse Wyvern Sting on the tank, never on anyone else (the sting on raiders here is not dispellable: leave them). Noxious Poison silences you for 8 seconds, so have the tank full before it lands.

taunt.label: Threat burst
taunt.tip: Build threat with melee attacks. This practice button combines several attacks; it cannot taunt or guarantee that the boss switches to you.

attack.label: Attack
attack.tip: Attacks generate threat. Stop when the threat bar turns red so the boss stays on the tank.

heal.label: Heal the tank
heal.tip: A large heal for the tank. Time it to land with the incoming damage.

dispel.label: Tranq / Cleanse
dispel.tip: Hunters: Tranquilizing Shot removes her Frenzy. Healers: Cleanse removes Wyvern Sting on the tank.

acidSpit.label: Acid Spit
acidSpit.tip: Stacks on the tank and ticks every second. Only the swap clears it.

restWindow.label: Waiting: your stacks are falling
restWindow.tip: The other tank has her. Press nothing for 30 seconds while your stacks fall.

swapOut.label: Tank swap
swapOut.toast: Tank swap: the other tank has her. Let your stacks fall.
swapOut.tip: Around eight stacks the next tank takes over.

frenzy.label: Frenzy
frenzy.tip: She enrages. Hunters, Tranq her now, inside 4 seconds.

poisonBolt.label: Poison Bolt
poisonBolt.tip: Frenzy made her spray the closest players. A Tranq in time stops it.

wyvernStingTank.label: Wyvern Sting: on the tank
wyvernStingTank.tip: A tank is asleep. Cleanse the tank immediately.

wyvernStingRaid.label: Wyvern Sting
wyvernStingRaid.tip: A 12 second sleep. Leave it alone: dispelling it costs 3,000 and wakes them.

noxiousPoison.label: Noxious Poison
noxiousPoison.tip: A poison and an 8 second silence that spreads 15 yards. Stay in small groups.

noxiousSilence.label: Silenced
noxiousSilence.tip: Silenced. Nothing to cast for 8 seconds.

berserk30.label: Berserk
berserk30.tip: At 30% she berserks. Soakers in, everyone healing them, and burn.

poisonBoltSoak.label: Poison Bolt
poisonBoltSoak.tip: From 30% she sprays the closest fifteen players every few seconds. That is what the soakers are for.

expectations.label: Hold her in the middle, facing north
expectations.tip: Face her away from the raid so only the tank eats her melee.

expectations.label: Take her back when your stacks are gone
expectations.tip: Let the 30 seconds run out, then build threat fast and take her back.

expectations.label: Tranq the Frenzy
expectations.tip: Tranquilizing Shot the moment she enrages. Four seconds later her Poison Bolt starts hitting the soakers.

expectations.label: Cleanse the tank, and only the tank
expectations.tip: Dispel Wyvern Sting on the tanks, nowhere else. Cleansing a raider costs them 3,000 and wakes them into the raid.

expectations.label: Stay spread, far from her
expectations.tip: In stacks of two or three, well away from her: Noxious Poison splashes 15 yards.

expectations.label: Do not press into Silence
expectations.tip: Eight seconds of no casting after Noxious Poison. Have your next heal ready for when it ends.

expectations.label: Never pull aggro off the tank
expectations.tip: Stop attacking while the threat bar is red. Resume when it leaves the red band.

expectations.label: Keep the tank alive
expectations.tip: Acid Spit never stops ticking. Keep the tank high going into a swap.

expectations.label: Keep the tank above half
expectations.tip: Stacks of Acid Spit make every tick worse. Be ahead of it.

expectations.label: Keep her in the middle
expectations.tip: Soakers need to know where to stand. Do not walk her.

expectations.label: Take her back when your stacks are gone
expectations.tip: Let the 30 seconds run out, then build threat fast and take her back.

expectations.label: Tranq the Frenzy
expectations.tip: Tranquilizing Shot the moment she enrages. Four seconds later her Poison Bolt starts hitting the soakers.

expectations.label: Cleanse the tank, and only the tank
expectations.tip: Dispel Wyvern Sting on the tanks, nowhere else. Cleansing a raider costs them 3,000 and wakes them into the raid.

expectations.label: Stay spread, far from her
expectations.tip: In stacks of two or three, well away from her: Noxious Poison splashes 15 yards.

expectations.label: Do not press into Silence
expectations.tip: Eight seconds of no casting after Noxious Poison. Have your next heal ready for when it ends.

expectations.label: Never pull aggro off the tank
expectations.tip: Stop attacking while the threat bar is red. Resume when it leaves the red band.

expectations.label: Keep the tank alive
expectations.tip: Acid Spit never stops ticking. Keep the tank high going into a swap.

expectations.label: Keep the tank above half
expectations.tip: Stacks of Acid Spit make every tick worse. Be ahead of it.

expectations.label: Hold her where the soakers are
expectations.tip: No movement now. Every bolt needs to land on the stack.

expectations.label: Soakers: stacked and in the closest fifteen
expectations.tip: Nature resist, Greater Nature Protection Potion, and stay stacked. If soakers die the bolts move onto cloth.

expectations.label: Stay far: no bolts on the ranged
expectations.tip: Never stand closer than the soakers. A casual step inward means a mage takes a bolt.

expectations.label: Never pull aggro off the tank
expectations.tip: Stop attacking while the threat bar is red. Resume when it leaves the red band.

expectations.label: Keep the tank alive
expectations.tip: Berserk: every heal you have, on the tank.

expectations.label: Keep the tank above half
expectations.tip: Stacks of Acid Spit make every tick worse. Be ahead of it.

threatLostCount.label: Times the boss turned on the raid

aggroPulls.label: Times you pulled aggro
aggroPulls.tip: Stop attacking when the threat bar turns red.

attacksInRed.label: Attacks in the red band
attacksInRed.tip: Stop attacking in the red band so the tank can regain a threat lead.

earlyAttacks.label: Attacks before the tank had the boss
earlyAttacks.tip: Give the tank a few seconds after the pull.

dpsIdle.label: Seconds not attacking when you could
dpsIdle.tip: Keep attacking when it's safe. Stop if the threat bar turns red or the boss leaves the tank.

playerInHazard.label: Seconds standing in something bad
playerInHazard.tip: Move out of the ground effect before attacking again.

tankLowSeconds.label: Seconds with the tank under half
tankLowSeconds.tip: Top the tank up before the spike lands, not after.

overheals.label: Wasted heals
overheals.tip: Avoid healing the tank at full health. Save the heal for incoming damage.

debuffSeconds.label: Seconds with a Frenzy or sting up
debuffSeconds.tip: Remove it fast. For hunters that means Tranq inside 4 seconds; for healers Wyvern Sting on the tank.

tauntedTooSoon.label: Took her back before your stacks fell

boltsTakenBerserk.label: Berserk bolts soaked
boltsTakenBerserk.tip: This is your job. Stay in the ring and stay healed.

castWhileSilenced.label: Pressed into Silence
castWhileSilenced.tip: Eight seconds of no casting. Press nothing until it ends.

cues.notes: Tranq on the Frenzy note, cleanse the tank, Taunt back after your stacks fall.

list.label: Take her back: your stacks are gone
list.tip: Wait the full 30 seconds, then build threat and take her back.

list.label: Heal the tank when they drop low
list.tip: Under half with stacks of Acid Spit is where tanks die.

list.label: Tranquilizing Shot
list.tip: The moment she enrages. Do not wait for the bolts to start.

list.label: Dispel it
list.tip: Cleanse Wyvern Sting on the tank. Leave it on everyone else.

drills.name: Stacks and the swap
drills.description: Acid Spit every 4 s and a swap every 42 s. Wait out the 30 s, then take her back.

drills.name: Tranq the Frenzy
drills.description: She Frenzies every 9 s. Tranq inside 4 seconds and stop the bolts before they start.

drills.name: Soaking the bolts
drills.description: Poison Bolt lands on the ring every 3 s with her berserk. Stay stacked and stay healed.

drills.name: Cleanse and silence
drills.description: Sting on the tank every 12 s and Noxious Poison. Cleanse the tank, wait out the Silence, and keep him up.

limitations: Poison Bolt Volley does not choose the nearest 15 players. Tank swaps and Frenzy removal are simplified.
